ideas.pitch: A labyrinth where pressing up moves you down, left is random, and completing the maze requires signing up for a fake newsletter every 3 steps.
ideas.problem_statement: The Worst Game Wins | 2-Day Online Game Jam: Make the worst game possible with complete, playable, and fully committed mechanics.
ideas.title: Reverse-Inversion Maze of Misdirection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages deliberate, high-effort bad design combined with rock-solid stability to fulfill the core judging criteria of maximum hilarity and complete playability.

ideas.pitch: A precision puzzle game where you can only control movement by shouting precise decibel levels into your mic, mapped to unpredictable character spasms.
ideas.problem_statement: The Worst Game Wins | 2-Day Online Game Jam: Make the worst game possible with complete, playable, and fully committed mechanics.
ideas.title: Voice-Controlled Stealth Slide Puzzle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a working audio tracking engine with absolute mechanical frustration, echoing successful live interactive demos from past game jams.

ideas.pitch: A retro platformer where every single jump requires reading and agreeing to a scrolling 500-word terms and conditions popup.
ideas.problem_statement: The Worst Game Wins | 2-Day Online Game Jam: Make the worst game possible with complete, playable, and fully committed mechanics.
ideas.title: The Infinite Disclaimer Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets judge amusement through pure UX agony while meeting all win/lose and basic UI requirements out of the box.

ideas.pitch: A double-pong game where one player must control two opposing paddles simultaneously using conflicting keyboard layouts.
ideas.problem_statement: The Worst Game Wins | 2-Day Online Game Jam: Make the worst game possible with complete, playable, and fully committed mechanics.
ideas.title: Dual-Cursor Single-Keyboard Tennis
ideas.why_it_could_win: Takes a proven classic game winning architecture and intentionally ruins the ergonomics to maximize rage and comedic judging reactions.

ideas.pitch: An educational resource-management game that aggressively shames the player with unskippable cutscenes every time they click to water a virtual plant.
ideas.problem_statement: The Worst Game Wins | 2-Day Online Game Jam: Make the worst game possible with complete, playable, and fully committed mechanics.
ideas.title: Guilt-Trip Hydration Tycoon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Subverts traditional serious educational games into an intentionally painful, fully polished interactive experience that leaves judges laughing.
